bio.en: Granny Li was widowed years ago and raised Li Da and Li Er on her own. Her grandchildren are around her now, and the Li family still comes to her for the big decisions.
bio.zh: 李老太守寡多年，独自把李大、李二拉扯大。如今孙辈也在跟前，李家的大事仍要她点头。

intro.en: Mother of Li Da and Li Er, with the final say on family matters.
intro.zh: 李大、李二的娘。李家有大事，得等老太太拿主意。

bio.en: Li Da is Granny Li's elder son. He looks after the bamboo grove and the family's stock, and leaves big decisions to his mother.
bio.zh: 李大是李老太的长子，管着家里的竹林和竹料。他做事稳当，拿不定的大事就去问娘。

intro.en: The eldest Li son looks after the family's bamboo grove and supplies. Granny Li still makes the big family decisions.
intro.zh: 李家长子，平日管竹林和竹料。家里有大事，还得先问老太太。

role.en: Eldest Li son, keeper of the bamboo

bio.en: Li Er is Granny Li's younger son and helps out at the lantern workshop, making round, bright lanterns. Young or old, people in town find him easy to talk to.
bio.zh: 李二是李老太的小儿子，在扎灯坊帮工。他糊的灯又圆又亮，镇上不论老少也都愿意跟他说几句。

intro.en: The younger Li son makes round, bright paper lanterns. Anyone passing the workshop can stop for a word.
intro.zh: 李家次子，在扎灯坊糊灯，糊出来的灯又圆又亮。街坊路过坊里，都能跟李二聊上两句。

bio.en: Shitou, Li Da's young son, runs down to the riverbank as soon as school lets out. He has a loud voice and can't keep a secret for long.
bio.zh: 石头是李大的小儿子。一放学就往河滩跑，嗓门又响，心里有事一会儿就说出来了。

intro.en: Shitou is Li Da's young son and rushes to the riverbank after school. Anyone Shitou shouts to along the way can hear from a long way off.
intro.zh: 石头是李大的小儿子，去私塾念书，一放学就往河滩跑。路上叫谁，隔老远都听得见。

bio.en: Li Xiaomei is Li Da's daughter. She often cuts paper and pastes lantern shades at the workshop, and the neighbours like having her around.
bio.zh: 李家小妹是李大的女儿，常到扎灯坊裁纸、糊灯。她手巧，说话也讨街坊喜欢。

intro.en: Li Da's daughter often cuts and pastes the paper at the lantern workshop. The neighbours like Xiaomei's quick hands and friendly chatter.
intro.zh: 李家的小妹是李大的女儿，平日常在扎灯坊裁纸糊灯，手巧也爱说话，街坊见了都喜欢。

bio.en: Shopkeeper Zhou has spent half his life selling timber, and most of the wood for the bridge is in his storehouse. Even friends have to settle the bill.
bio.zh: 周掌柜卖了半辈子木料，修桥要用的木料大半在他家库里。熟人来买，也得把账算清。

intro.en: Half a lifetime in the timber trade. Most of the timber needed to mend the bridge is in the Zhou storehouse.
intro.zh: 做了半辈子木料买卖。修桥要用的木料，大半得从周家库里出。

role.en: Head of the Zhou shop, keeper of the timber

bio.en: Madam Zhou, the shopkeeper's wife, goes to the market every day. She's quick to hear the neighbours' news and just as quick to pass it on.
bio.zh: 周娘子是周掌柜的妻子，天天去集市走动。谁家有点新鲜事，她听得早，说出去也快。

intro.en: Shopkeeper Zhou's wife goes to the market every day and often hears the neighbours' news before the market breaks up.
intro.zh: 周娘子是周掌柜的媳妇，每天要到集市走一走。街坊谁家有了新消息，常常没等集散，周娘子就听说了。

bio.en: Zhou Dalang is the shopkeeper's elder son and hauls timber and runs errands for the business. He's strong and quick to anger, and heads for the tavern when work's done.
bio.zh: 周家大郎是周掌柜的长子，平日帮家里搬木料、跑买卖。他力气大，脾气也不小，忙完了就往酒肆去。

intro.en: Shopkeeper Zhou's eldest son carries timber and helps with business. Zhou Dalang has the strength for the heavy work and a temper that flares easily.
intro.zh: 周掌柜的长子替家里扛木料，也帮着跑买卖。大郎做重活有的是力气，遇事却容易发火。

role.en: Eldest Zhou son, quick to anger

bio.en: Zhou Erlang is the shopkeeper's younger son, a mild fellow who runs errands at the market and by the river. However badly the families quarrel, he still says hello when he sees someone from the Li family.
bio.zh: 周家二郎是周掌柜的次子，性子温和，常替家里跑集市和河边。两家再怎么吵，他见了李家人也照样问好。

intro.en: Shopkeeper Zhou's second son runs errands at the market or by the river. Erlang still stops to greet people from the Li family and rarely quarrels.
intro.zh: 二郎是周掌柜的次子，常替家里去集市和河边办事。见着李家人也照样招呼一声，平日很少跟人争执。

bio.en: Zhou's Clerk has worked for the family for years, works quickly and remembers what's said. When there's a decision to make, the answer is still "Ask the shopkeeper."
bio.zh: 周家伙计帮工好些年了，手脚勤快，听过的话也记得牢。要拿主意的时候，还是一句「掌柜的说了算」。

intro.en: A quick hand at the Zhou shop for years. When there's a decision to make, the answer is still “Ask the shopkeeper.”
intro.zh: 在周家铺子干了好些年，手脚麻利。真要拿主意，还是一句「您问掌柜的去」。

bio.en: The Teahouse Keeper has served tea by the river for over ten years, and people bring the town's news to her tables. Once a story has made the rounds there, it usually leaves with a few details added.
bio.zh: 老板娘在河边开了十几年茶馆，镇上的事总有人端着茶来讲。一件事在这儿讲过几桌，传出去常会多出几句。

intro.en: Over ten years running the teahouse by the river. The neighbours usually hear the latest news before the tea is gone.
intro.zh: 这间茶馆在河边开了十几年。哪家有点新消息，茶还没喝完，桌上往往已经说开了。

bio.en: The Schoolmaster teaches the children to read and write and puts out the Town Gazette. People in town who can read tend to believe what they see in it.
bio.zh: 私塾先生教孩子念书识字，还办《镇报》。街坊里识字的人见一件事登了报，多半就当真了。

intro.en: The schoolmaster teaches children to read and puts out the Town Gazette. When townspeople can't make sense of something, some of them look to see what the Gazette says.
intro.zh: 私塾先生教孩子识字，也办一份《镇报》。街坊碰到闹不明白的事，有时会看看报上怎么说。

role.en: Schoolmaster, editor of the Town Gazette

bio.en: Boatman He has worked the crossing for over twenty years, and just about everyone in town has ridden the ferry. Once ashore, the boatman seldom talks about what's been seen out on the river.
bio.zh: 老何在渡口摆了二十多年船，镇上熟人基本都坐过。河上看见的事，老何很少在岸上拿出来讲。

intro.en: The ferry at the landing has been in the boatman's hands for over twenty years. Most townspeople crossing by water take that boat.
intro.zh: 老何在渡口摆船有二十多年了，镇上人要是走水路过河，多半就坐老何这条船。

bio.en: As Chengxi's most senior elder, he settles clan rules and manages the hall. This year he chose to bring in an outsider to run the festival.
bio.zh: 澄溪论辈分数族长最高，族里的规矩、祠堂的事都由他拿主意。这回请外乡人管灯会，也是他定下的。

intro.en: Chengxi's senior elder runs the Ancestral Hall and chose an outsider to manage this year's festival.
intro.zh: 澄溪辈分最高的长辈，管着祠堂，也拿主意请了个外乡人来办今年的灯会。

bio.en: The Accountant keeps the town's books. Look in the ledger for what was spent on the bridge, the roads or the festival.
bio.zh: 全镇的公账归账房管。修桥、修路、办灯会，钱花在哪儿都能翻账本查到。

intro.en: The bridge, the roads and the festival are all paid for out of the town's funds. The accountant records who spent what, item by item.
intro.zh: 镇上修桥、修路、办灯会，用的都是公账里的钱，谁支了多少，账房要一笔一笔记下来。

bio.en: The Temple Keeper has tended the little temple for most of her life. She keeps the key to the lane behind it, which is usually locked.
bio.zh: 庙祝在镇上的小庙里守了大半辈子香火。庙后的夹道平时锁着，钥匙就在她手里。

intro.en: The temple keeper has tended the shrine for most of a lifetime and keeps the key to the usually locked passage behind the temple.
intro.zh: 庙祝在小庙守了大半辈子的香火，平日庙后夹道是锁着的，那把钥匙就在庙祝手里。

bio.en: Xiaoman lives by the river, often fishes alone at night and gets sleepy in the daytime. Most grown-ups put anything Xiaoman says down to a child's imagination.
bio.zh: 小满家就在河边，夜里常独自在河滩钓鱼，白天就犯困。大人们听两句，多半只当是孩子话。

intro.en: Xiaoman lives by the river and loves to fish from the bank, sometimes staying out even after dark.
intro.zh: 小满家就在河边，最爱坐在岸上钓鱼，有时到了夜里还舍不得回去。

role.en: A child from a riverside house

bio.en: The Night Watchman has called the hours with a gong for over ten years, walking along the river and across the bridge. The watchman likes a drink, so neighbours take those accounts of the night with a grain of salt.
bio.zh: 更夫打了十几年更，每晚提着锣沿河走，再过石桥。打更的爱喝两口，街坊听到夜里的事，总要打个折扣。

intro.en: The watchman has made the night round in Chengxi for over ten years. At night, townspeople know the sound of that gong through their doors.
intro.zh: 更夫在澄溪打了十几年更，镇上人到了夜里，隔着门也认得那几声锣。

bio.en: If a door, window, table or chair breaks, people find the Carpenter at the bench in the lantern workshop. The bridge will need the Carpenter's help if any timber has to be replaced.
bio.zh: 镇上有谁的门窗桌椅坏了，就去扎灯坊的工台找木匠。石桥要换木料，也少不了木匠动手。

intro.en: The carpenter has a bench at the lantern workshop. People bring chairs, tables, doors and windows there for repair. The bridge woodwork gets done there too.
intro.zh: 木匠在扎灯坊支了一张工台，哪家的桌椅、门窗要修，都可以拿到这儿来。镇上修桥的木工活也归这儿。

bio.en: The Lantern Maker has been at it for thirty years. She makes the main lantern that leads the parade each year, and this year's lanterns are already half done.
bio.zh: 扎灯师傅做了三十年灯，每年走在游灯队伍最前头的主灯都是她扎的。今年要用的灯已经做了一半。

intro.en: The lantern maker has been at it for thirty years. Every year the lead lantern for the parade comes from the workshop. This year's lanterns are halfway done.
intro.zh: 扎灯师傅做了三十年，每年游灯走在头里的主灯，都是从扎灯坊抬出去的。今年的灯已经扎了一半。
